name: Dry Institutional
description: Evaluation fixture A: thin restrained linework, blank faces, glacial pacing. Everything is fine. Nothing is fine.

setNotes: Rooms are under-furnished and over-lit. Two props where five would fit.
Perfect symmetry is allowed here, because institutions love it and it reads as dread.
Nothing personal is visible anywhere: no posters, no plants, no colour accents.
Every surface is a regulation surface.

register: Nobody raises their voice, ever. The worse the news, the quieter the delivery.
Dialogue is procedural language: forms, policies, scheduled outcomes.
Feelings are referred to in the third person, if at all.
Jokes are never acknowledged as jokes.

pacing: Long silences are the default punctuation; let them run past comfortable.
One pause per exchange should be noticeably too long.
